entrance: The Eastwall Gate, a little east of the main gate of Stratholme. It needs the Key to the City. The Undead side can also be reached through the Living side.

6163.objective: Kill Ramstein the Gorger in Slaughter Square and bring back his head.
6163.note: First do the five quests of Nathanos Blightcaller in the Eastern Plaguelands, two of them elite. Horde only.

5243.objective: Loot 5 Stratholme Holy Water from the supply crates along the streets.
5243.note: Some crates are trapped and release Plagued Insects.

5212.objective: Loot 20 Plagued Flesh Samples from undead in Stratholme.
5212.note: The Forever data asks for 20 samples, Classic asked for 10. Skeletons drop none. Turn it in mid-run to do The Active Agent in the same run.

5213.objective: Find the Scourge Data in a small box in one of the three ziggurats.
5213.note: The ziggurats are guarded by Nerub'enkan, Baroness Anastari and Maleki the Pallid.

5125.objective: Talk to Aurius after the fight with Baron Rivendare.
5125.note: If someone in the group turned in The Medallion of Faith during this lockout, Aurius joins the fight against the Baron.

5263.objective: Kill Baron Rivendare and bring the Head of Baron Rivendare to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff.
5263.note: Follows The Archivist and The Truth Comes Crashing Down on the Living side.

5463.objective: Place the Keepsake of Remembrance on Menethil's Gift, the glowing symbol on the floor in front of Baron Rivendare.
5463.note: Part of the chain that starts with Doctor Theolen Krastinov, the Butcher in Scholomance and ends with The Lich, Ras Frostwhisper.

8945.objective: Free Ysida Harmon from Baron Rivendare.
8945.note: Part of the chain for the Tier 0.5 sets. Opening the Gauntlet Gate starts a timer of 45 minutes; after that the Baron kills his prisoner.
